title: Reverse-ETL Records Rejected by Destination
dataSources: Hightouch sync run events (`hightouch:sync`), Census sync history (`census:sync`), Segment/RudderStack destination delivery and error events, audience-refresh latency metrics via REST.
app: Hightouch / Census sync webhooks and REST APIs via HEC; Segment/RudderStack delivery events via HEC scripted inputs.
spl:
index=dataops (sourcetype=hightouch:sync OR sourcetype=census:sync) event=sync_completed
| stats sum(records_processed) as processed, sum(records_rejected) as rejected by sync_name, destination
| eval reject_pct=round(100*rejected/processed,1)
| where rejected>0
| sort - reject_pct
description: Surfaces records rejected by the destination during otherwise-successful reverse-ETL syncs, catching validation and mapping problems a pass/fail status hides.
value: A sync can report success while silently dropping thousands of records the destination rejected; reject-rate monitoring catches partial activation failures.
implementation: Ingest sync completion events with processed/rejected counts; schedule hourly; alert on high reject rates.
visualization: Table by reject rate, timechart of rejected records.
grandmaExplanation: We flag when data pushed to a business tool is quietly rejected, so records do not silently go missing.
